explanation: Cogsworth is the clock, Mrs Potts the teapot and the wardrobe is a former opera singer. The film was the first animated feature nominated for the Oscar for Best Picture.

claims.text: In Beauty and the Beast (1991), Lumière is an enchanted candelabra.
Cogsworth is a clock, Mrs Potts is a teapot and the Wardrobe is a former opera singer; Lumière is none of these.
Beauty and the Beast (1991) was the first animated feature nominated for the Academy Award for Best Picture.

writerNotes: Self-check 9.3. Lint: clean. Volatility: evergreen; no time words; nothing depends on events after mid-2026. Regional: a worldwide release; the objects are everyday ones. Style: Oxford spelling, straight single quotes, plain hyphens, explanation of 30 words. Myths: claims screened against myths.json; no claim resembles a listed myth. claimResults.note: Uncertain on one part only: the clock, the teapot and the point that Lumière is none of these are certain. The opera-singer detail may belong to the adaptations rather than the 1991 film, and it is repeated as fact in the explanation. Without a search I cannot settle it, so it needs external evidence in a follow-up, or the clause should go.
